crossRefs.note: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen these.”
translations.bsb: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel told him, “The LORD has not chosen any of these.”
translations.kjv: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.
translations.asv: And Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Jehovah hath not chosen these.
